attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as authoritative DNS for app.internal -> node2's IP via dnsmasq/UCI, pointed node3 at node1 for DNS via a persistent systemd-networkd drop-in, and verified node3 resolves app.internal and reaches node2's HTTP service on port 8080 with no /etc/hosts entry. Also had to stand up the HTTP listener on node2 (none was running). Completed the mandatory sequential-restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-id and functional proof before/after each.
